commits.subject: Gate plugin recommendation cache warming on feature flags (#60721)
commits.reason: Gate recommendation cache warming on the effective apps/plugins and recommendation flags. This closes unwanted recommendation background work with ALab packaged apps=false/plugins=false/tool_suggest=false, while retaining installed-plugin refresh and explicit user opt-in. Test helpers now disable recommendation flags explicitly and recommendation scenarios opt in; config RPC assertions retain the resulting SessionFlags layer. Retain ALab packaged-default precedence and lifecycle fixture adapters. Source review complete; exact-candidate feature scenarios, focused regressions and full native qualification remain pending.
evidence: Reviewed all thirteen changed paths at fe2f18520864ddbee86cdd4b103a9fefffe9c6a2 against 5228d94a27b7f84cae4854acbb5ea3b3e90dfeaf.
core-plugins/src/manager.rs: installed-plugin refresh precedes the new recommendation-only early return; builder defaults false and config supplies Features::plugin_recommendations_enabled().
features/src/lib.rs: predicate requires apps && plugins && (tool_suggest || recommended_plugins); alab-core/defaults.toml disables apps/plugins/tool_suggest without overriding explicit user settings.
app-server config RPC tests assert session feature overrides; external-login recommendation tests opt in separately through tool_suggest or recommended_plugins.
commits.revisit: Before integration lands, complete both declared feature contracts, test recommendation-disabled no-request behavior and enabled warming, and run the native full gate on the exact composed candidate.
